name: Secrets Impression Isla Mujeres
insider_take: This adults-only paradise sits on a pristine stretch of Isla Mujeres, where ancient Mayan goddess Ixchel was once worshipped and Caribbean waters shimmer in impossible shades of turquoise.
whats_special: Located on the "Island of Women" - named by Spanish conquistadors who discovered numerous female deity statues here. The resort occupies one of the most stunning coastlines in the Mexican Caribbean, where the Gulf of Mexico meets the Caribbean Sea. Isla Mujeres was considered sacred by the Maya civilization, dedicated to Ixchel, goddess of love and fertility.
pro_tip: Wake up early to catch sunrise from the easternmost point of Mexico - Isla Mujeres is the first place in the country to see each new day.
dont_miss: The underwater museum (MUSA) just offshore features over 500 life-sized sculptures submerged in crystal-clear waters, creating an otherworldly snorkeling experience. Punta Sur's sculpture garden and lighthouse offer breathtaking views where ancient Mayan temples once stood overlooking the vast Caribbean horizon.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location on pristine Isla Mujeres
All-inclusive luxury with premium dining and beverage options
Adults-only sophisticated atmosphere ideal for romantic getaways
World-class spa and wellness facilities with ocean views
cons: Adults-only property not suitable for families with children
Island location requires ferry or boat transfer from mainland
